response.justification: The candidate substantially exceeds the 6+ years experience bar with nearly two decades of full-stack work, strong TypeScript/Node.js production experience, recent hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling development, and a demonstrated testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks). Gaps are mostly around specific stack items — Nest.js, Kotlin, and Vitest are not explicitly mentioned, and much frontend experience is Ember rather than React — but these are learnable given the depth shown elsewhere.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js full-stack experience across multiple production companies, plus recent AI-agent/MCP development matching the required AI experience
Strong testing and engineering-practice background: TDD, pairing, trunk-based development, and authored open-source testing libraries
Broad polyglot and infrastructure skills: cloud (AWS CDK), Kubernetes/Docker, MongoDB/SQL, and high-performance backend systems
concerns: No explicit Nest.js or Vitest/Jest experience listed despite being core to the primary stack
Kotlin absent and Java experience appears dated/limited for the secondary backend stack
Frontend depth leans heavily on Ember.js; React exposure appears limited to one recent role

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js and limited React/Kotlin alignment
